description: Implementation of platform service for retrieving various dropdown options related to charges in Fineract, including calculation types, applicable entities, collection time types, payment modes, and loan, savings, client, and share-specific details.

classes.name: ChargeDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve lists of enum options for various charge-related dropdowns for different contexts such as loans, savings, clients, and shares.

methods.name: retrieveCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of charge calculation types (flat, percent of amount, etc.)

methods.name: retrieveApplicableToTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of entities to which charges can apply

methods.name: retrieveCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of applicable collection time types, excluding invalid and savings closure types

methods.name: retrivePaymentModes
methods.description: Returns a list of payment modes (regular, account transfer)

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of loan-specific calculation types

methods.name: retrieveLoanCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of loan-specific collection time types

methods.name: retrieveSavingsCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of savings calculation types

methods.name: retrieveSavingsCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of savings collection time types, including fees and activation types

methods.name: retrieveClientCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns calculation types applicable to clients

methods.name: retrieveClientCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns collection time types applicable to clients
